summary: Backend-only verification of Xcel Green Button Connect refactor (4 critical fixes from GBC Vendor Startup Guide). Created /app/ross-house-backend/tests/test_xcel_greenbutton_fixes.py with 9 pytest cases — ALL PASS. Verified: (1) module imports cleanly, (2) router exposes exactly 19 routes including new GET /admin/xcel/read-service-status, (3) _get_client_credentials_token uses BasicAuth + grant_type=client_credentials + scope=FB=34_35 and CACHES on second call (only 1 httpx instance created), (4) xcel_sync_connection POSTs (not GETs) to /Batch/Subscription/{sub_id} and treats HTTP 202 as success returning mode='asynchronous' + Location header, (5) parse_espi_feed + _ingest_espi_xml correctly parse IntervalReadings (Wh→kWh) and UsageSummary (cost/100000) and persist to xcel_usage_daily + xcel_usage_summaries (verified upsert calls + last_sync update on xcel_connections), (6) xcel_notify extracts <resources> URL from Atom XML, obtains client_credentials token, downloads with Bearer auth, resolves property_id via subscription_id lookup, and ingests via _ingest_espi_xml. Frontend regression check: Expo web at localhost:3000 still bundles and renders the Ross House Rentals welcome screen on mobile viewport (390x844) — no red screen, no console errors (only deprecation warnings unrelated to this change). NOTE: legacy /app/backend/server.py is broken (KeyError: MONGO_URL) but per main-agent instructions that is unrelated and must NOT be started.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo doctor warns about version drift: expo@54.0.34 vs ~54.0.35, expo-router@6.0.23 vs ~6.0.24, react-native-svg@15.15.5 vs 15.12.1, react-native-worklets@0.5.2 vs 0.5.1, expo-device, expo-document-picker, expo-file-system, expo-font, expo-image-picker, expo-local-authentication, expo-secure-store, expo-updates. Run `npx expo install --check` to align. Pre-existing — not introduced by this change.

Console warns 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow / textShadow). Also props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Pre-existing — not part of the Xcel refactor.

critical_code_review_comments: All 4 GBC spec fixes correctly implemented and match the Vendor Startup Guide: POST async Batch, Notification webhook ingests <resources>, client_credentials with scope=FB=34_35, new ReadServiceStatus admin endpoint.
_get_client_credentials_token cache is in-process-only — acceptable, just be aware on multi-worker deployments.
Notification handler gracefully degrades: if XML parse fails, falls back to regex sweep for Batch URLs. Good defensive coding.
_ingest_espi_xml is correctly shared between sync_connection (inline 200 path) and the notify webhook — DRY upheld.
xcel_energy_router.py is 1421 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules: oauth.py, ingest.py, demo.py, llm_tips.py. Not blocking.
